```sql
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    DATE_TRUNC('year', p.Birthday) AS Birthday,
    SPLIT_PART(p.Diagnosis, ' ', 1) AS Diagnosis,
    COUNT(*) AS abnormal_lab_count
FROM main."Patient" p
INNER JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' 
  AND l."Date" < DATE '1998-01-01'
  AND l.GOT >= 60
GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX, DATE_TRUNC('year', p.Birthday), SPLIT_PART(p.Diagnosis, ' ', 1)
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
```
